simple.summary: רִיר (rîyr) means saliva ; by resemblance, broth First listed occurrence: 1Sam 21 14.

definitions.full: H7388. riyr רִיר noun masculine slimy juice, spittle ; — construct חַלָּמוּת בְּרִיר Job 6:6 in the juice of ׳ח (al. slime of yolk , i.e. white of egg); suffix דִירוֺ 1Sam 21:14 his spittle . רִישׁ רֵישׁ, see רושׁ . רִישׁוֺן see ראשׁון רֹךְ רַךְ, see רבך
